description: This file defines the IPTestAdministrator class, which manages inter-process communication for testing purposes, including handshake signaling and waiting mechanisms, using shared memory and atomic operations.

classes.name: IPTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that facilitates inter-process communication for testing, using shared memory and atomic handshake values, with methods for waiting and signaling.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test administrator with parent and child callbacks, handshake value, and wait time.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the handshake value to match the expected value.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Signals the next handshake value, with optional retries.

methods.name: WaitTimeDivisor
methods.description: Returns the divisor used for wait time calculations.
